skills.name: Toyako Slash (洞爺湖斬撃)
skills.description: Gintoki attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 125% and has 20% base chance to inflict the enemy with Taunt, lasts for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sugar Rush (糖分追撃)
skills.description:
:''(This skill triggers when an enemy is inflicted with Taunt or Provocation.)''
Gintoki increases his move bar by 5% and and inflicts the enemy with Seal, lasts for 1 turn. Then he attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 198% of his ATK, when attacking monsters the damage increases to 297%.

skills.name: Sugar Content (糖分)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect. Gintoki gains 6 stacks of Sugar at the start of battle and his turn. When the enemy is inflicted with Taunt or Provocation, and if he isn't inflicted with a control effect or Banish and similar effects, he will consume 1 stack of Sugar to attack the enemy with Sugar Rush.
;
:
;Sugar (糖分)
:
:'''Buff, Mark''': Each layer increases RES by 10%, HIT by 5%, DEF by 5% and ATK by 5%.

skills.name: Silver Soul (銀ノ魂)
skills.description: Gintoki attacks all enemies 3 times, dealing damage equal to 62% of his ATK with each attack. Also has a 12% base chance to inflict Provocation on a selected target and inflicts Taunt on every other enemy.

bio.condition: Team Gintoki with another player's Kagura & Sadaharu and clear any zone 10 times.
